title: Machine characterization of NP
statement: The class of languages whose membership has polynomial-length certificates checked by a polynomial-time verifier is exactly the union, over natural numbers $c$, of the nondeterministic time classes with bounds $n^c+1$: $\mathrm{NP}=\bigcup_{c\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{NTIME}(n\mapsto n^c+1)$.
replaced: The class $\mathrm{NP}$, defined by polynomial-time verifiers with certificates of exact polynomial length, equals the union $\bigcup_{c} \mathrm{NTIME}(n^c + 1)$ of the fixed-degree nondeterministic time classes.
